# Le022 — Non-ASCII / Japanese / Greek Unicode in PRODUCT.name via `\X2\…\X0\`

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

## Description

STEP names and PMI annotation strings carry Unicode using the spec-conformant `\X2\…\X0\` directive. Older OCCT did not decode the directives at all and emitted question-mark replacements. Some downstream tools (Excel, legacy ANSI receivers) cannot render the result because they lack full Unicode font support, but the file itself is conformant.

## Reproducer recipe

`PRODUCT('\X2\03B1\X0\','alpha','desc',...);` (Greek alpha); Japanese characters embedded as `\X2\…\X0\` in `NAME` field.

## Expected kernel behavior

decode all control directives during read; pass through as Unicode; provide `read.step.codepage` for legacy files where the producer used 8-bit code pages instead.
